div.div: مَوقِذٌ An extremity of the person, (K,) or place upon which a blow is severe, (A,) as, (K,) or namely, (A,) the elbow, (A, L, K,) and shoulder-joint, (K,) or extremity of the shoulderjoint, (A, L,) and knee, and ankle-bone: pl. مَوَاقِذُ. (A, L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
